# Silver Hand Home & Landscaping

> Local lawn care and landscaping company serving Silver Spring and nearby areas of Montgomery County, Maryland (USA). Services: lawn care and mowing, landscaping, seasonal yard care, power washing, car washing and home cleaning. The same crew comes to the property every visit, customers get a text before the crew arrives, and the price is agreed up front after a free visit.

The website is a single page in English. Each part of the page has its own anchor link, listed below. To get a quote, people book a free visit with the form on the page; the crew comes by, walks the property and gives a clear plan and price.

## Services

- [Lawn care & mowing](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#lawn-care-mowing): Recurring mowing on a regular schedule, with the same crew every visit and a yard that looks great week after week.
- [Landscaping](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#services): Landscaping and landscape maintenance, recurring or seasonal.
- [Seasonal yard care](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#seasonal-care): Spring cleanups, fresh mulch and new growth; summer mowing and landscape maintenance; fall leaf removal and property protection; winter care to keep the property clean and safe.
- [Power washing](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#services): Power washing for homes.
- [Car washing](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#services): Car washing at home.
- [Home cleaning](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#services): Home cleaning.

## How it works

- [Why choose Silver Hand and how it works](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#work): Same crew at your property, a text before we arrive, price agreed up front. Three steps: send the request, we come and price it, pick a day and we begin.
- [Book a free visit](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#book): Form with name, phone, property address and the service wanted.

## Service area and questions

- [Service area](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#service-area): Silver Spring and nearby areas in Montgomery County, Maryland.
- [FAQ](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/#faq): Areas served; how to get a quote (book a free visit, price agreed up front); recurring service (yes, mowing and landscape maintenance on a regular schedule with the same crew); bad weather (if rain or storms make it unsafe, we text you and move the visit to the next open day).

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://silverrhand.pages.dev/privacy): How the information shared in the booking form, calls and texts is collected, used and protected.
